questions.cardText:
[Astronomy] What are usually at the center of most large galaxies?
A. Expansive fields of interstellar dust
B. Bright clusters of young stars
C. Supermassive black holes
Answer: C. The black hole at the center of the Milky Way has a mass equal to that of four million suns.
questions.de: Welche Art von Objekt befindet sich im Zentrum fast jeder großen Galaxie – im Fall der Milchstraße eines von rund vier Millionen Sonnenmassen?
questions.en: What kind of object sits at the centre of almost every large galaxy — in the Milky Way's case one of about four million solar masses?

timeline.labelEn: Bruce Balick and Robert Brown discover Sagittarius A*, the radio source at the Milky Way's centre
timeline.labelDe: Bruce Balick und Robert Brown entdecken Sagittarius A*, die Radioquelle im Zentrum der Milchstraße

questions.notes: The Milky Way's black hole Sagittarius A* is now measured at about 4.3 million solar masses.

questions.cardText:
[Physics] At what temperature is water most dense?
A. 32 °F (0 °C)
B. 39.2 °F (4 °C)
C. 122 °F (50 °C)
Answer: B. Due to hydrogen bonding, water expands slightly as it cools below 39.2 °F and forms ice. This is why ice floats on water, as it is less dense than liquid water. This property plays a crucial role in aquatic ecosystems, allowing life to thrive beneath the ice during cold periods.
questions.de: Bei welcher Temperatur (in Grad Celsius) hat flüssiges Wasser seine größte Dichte?
questions.en: At what temperature (in degrees Celsius) does liquid water reach its greatest density?

timeline.labelEn: Thomas Charles Hope publishes his experiment showing that water is densest at about 4 °C
timeline.labelDe: Thomas Charles Hope veröffentlicht sein Experiment, das zeigt, dass Wasser bei etwa 4 °C am dichtesten ist
